claims.text: Over the 7 days from the patch, the positive share was +20.2 points against the interrupted time series estimate of what it would have been without the patch (90% range -10.7 to +51.0). That isn't enough to credit the patch: its 90% range includes no change at all.
Positive reviews mentioning performance rose by 17.84 points in the window compared to baseline.
Positive share in the window reached 78.63 percent across 1460 total reviews.
The window experienced 0 sale days and 0 discount days.
Off-topic negative reviews changed by -0.23 percentage points in the window.
Reviewers with over 200 hours of playtime made up 30.14 percent of the window mix.

report.summary: Positive share in the window reached 78.63 percent across 1460 total reviews, with positive reviews mentioning performance rising by 17.84 points compared to baseline. Over the 7 days from the patch, the positive share was +20.2 points against the estimate without the patch, though its 90% range includes no change at all. The window experienced 0 sale days and 0 discount days, and off-topic negative reviews changed by -0.23 percentage points, while reviewers with over 200 hours of playtime made up 30.14 percent of the mix. Off-topic reviews or a review bomb and noise or seasonality are rejected. The patch, a price change or sale, and a change in who reviewed are inconclusive.
